executive_summary: The market experienced a powerful relief and momentum rally, posting its best session since April 2025 following the surprise reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. This dramatic reversal completely neutralized recent artificial intelligence spending fears, igniting massive double-digit gains across major semiconductor, cloud infrastructure, and software equities.

recommendations.strategy: Scale in on minor intraday pullbacks; maintain trailing stops to protect short-term parabolic gains.
recommendations.risk: Governance oversight questions and elevated valuation scrutiny following rapid volatility.
